player_prompt.intro:
Marhaba s ɣezzif n Ugelmam!

Ketwaliḍ s 'P' ɣef tawla.
Iswalen n tawla:
  ' ' = Tajwalit (tettɛadad ɣer tzemmɛt)
  'H' = Aḍɛw (ɣel s tzemmɛt d-tɛmmut!)
  'G' = Anegmu (ɣer tzemmɛt d-tawwet!)
  'P' = Adɣar inu

Imaɛaden iɛeddanen: agmuḍ, adfel, azelmaḍ, ayfus (neɣ w, a, s, d)
Ar tɛkki tawla-k s: [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d]

Inejjifen: ɣer tzemmɛt seg tazwara (deg ufella-azelmaḍ) ɣer anegmu (deg wadda-ayfus) war ma tɛmmut ɣer kraygat tiḍɛwin!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Aɣawas '{action}' ur ittwassan. Sqedc up, down, left, right, neɣ w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Tɛḍḍaḍ ad tɛḍḍaḍ {action} maca tɣamaḍ ɣef uɣṛuḍ!

outcome.fell_in_hole: Tɛkkes-ten ɣef kku yiɣzu! Tɣimit tɣimi. Tekkes-ten {pct}% n uɣzu ɣer ammud.
outcome.turn_limit: Tekkes-ten aseggas n tɣimit! Tɣimit tɣimi. Tekkes-ten {pct}% n uɣzu ɣer ammud.
